scope:
Bounded affine CFG search from exact shared-parameter base producers.

Candidates, not semantics or non-use proof. Ghidra instruction boundaries and
whole byte extents are primary; path flags are overapproximated. Calls, escapes,
unknown jumps and bounded queues remain explicit. x86 arithmetic is modulo32.
limits: Not full interprocedural analysis. Pointer forwards and escapes remain leads.
Conditional flags not constrained; paths overapproximate feasible execution.
One-symbol modular address overlap is exact for its explicit domain; multi-symbol results are necessary conditions only.
Nonvolatile preservation assumes standard MSVC ABI; volatile registers and stack aliases are killed on unknown calls.
String/repeat instructions and unhandled pointer transforms/partial writes are explicit stops.
No global non-use conclusion and no new meanings for29/186.
